subject.title: feat(channels): batch 1 producers drop media placeholder bodies

question: Should `formatMediaPlaceholderText` and `MediaPlaceholderTextFact` become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract for text-only channel carriers?
rationale: The implementation can be internally coherent while still creating a long-lived external API; correctness review alone cannot choose whether that shared contract should exist rather than remain owner-local.

options.title: Approve the shared SDK contract
options.body: Keep the public exports, document their intended stability, and require redacted real-channel behavior proof before merging.

options.title: Keep formatting owner-local
options.body: Remove the new public exports and retain the formatter only in the channel owner that currently needs its text-only carrier behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve the shared SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the public exports, document their intended stability, and require redacted real-channel behavior proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the related merged structured-media contract and are best positioned to explain the intended shared API boundary.
